clue.text: Bigger-than-normal nurse in port

parts.note: OS is the clothing-size abbreviation for outsize, bigger than the normal range
to nurse a patient is to tend them

explanation.surface: A nurse of unusual size is working down at the harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: OS (outsize) is a label on clothing; OSTEND is a Belgian ferry port.
explanation.definitionFit: Ostend is a Belgian harbour town on the North Sea coast, so it is an example of a port.

clue.text: After five a visitor becomes most absent-minded

indicators.note: the remaining pieces come after the Roman numeral, so it heads the word

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
a visitor to your home is a guest

explanation.surface: Once five o'clock comes, a house guest grows very forgetful.
explanation.definitionFit: Vague can describe a dreamy, unfocused person, so the superlative fits someone extremely absent-minded.

clue.text: Takes a safe course in the UK and stays with 'old labour'?

definitions.text: Takes a safe course in the UK
definitions.meaning: British traffic drives on the left side, so a careful driver stays on that side of the road
Old Labour is the traditional socialist wing of the British Labour Party, so loyalty to it means remaining on the political left

explanation.surface: A British motorist who drives carefully also clings to traditional socialist politics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old Labour' is the pre-Blair, more socialist form of the UK Labour Party.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both hugging one side of the road and remaining loyal to socialist politics.

clue.text: Important time of year

definitions.meaning: ... as an adjective means dignified and imposing
the eighth month of the calendar

explanation.definitionFit: Lower-case august means distinguished or eminent; capitalised it is the summer month.

clue.text: The charm of a piano accompanied by bells

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly
a peal is a set of bells or the sound of them ringing

explanation.surface: Part of a piano's attraction is that it can be played alongside church bells.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accompanied by' simply joins the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Appeal as a noun is attractiveness, the quality of drawing people in, which is what charm is.

clue.text: None of a radical disposition, OK?

definitions.meaning: if every member leans to the political right wing, nobody is a left-wing radical
a casual word of agreement or acceptability

explanation.walkthrough: Read the first part as 'all are right-wing', the opposite of radical.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an everyday synonym for acceptable, and split up it can mean everyone is right-wing.

clue.text: Sheet of glass left in compartment

parts.note: a pane is a single sheet of glass in a window

explanation.surface: A glass sheet has been left inside a compartment.
explanation.definitionFit: A panel is a distinct section set into a frame, such as one division of a door, so a compartment.

clue.text: Star, I somehow attempt to display superior skill

indicators.note: something done somehow is done in some unspecified way, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: to attempt something is to try it

explanation.surface: A celebrity performer tries to show off great talent.
explanation.definitionFit: Artistry is great creative ability or craftsmanship, a superior skill.

clue.text: A king with energy in call for drastic change

indicators.note: the first group of letters goes inside the word for call

parts.note: to call out loudly is to shout
K is the chess abbreviation for king
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A monarch with lots of vigour demands radical reform.
explanation.definitionFit: A shake-out is a reorganisation that removes weaker elements, a sweeping change in a business or market.

clue.text: Long-distance travellers needing time in aircraft

indicators.note: the letter for time goes inside the word for aircraft

parts.note: aircraft in the plural are planes

explanation.surface: People flying far must spend hours on board their flights.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests passengers; the travellers are worlds circling the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Planets travel immense distances in their orbits, so the definition is a playful description of them.

clue.text: Issue one penny with English queen on it

indicators.note: the abbreviations for English and queen are placed before the rest

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A coin is minted bearing the English monarch's head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on it' puts E and QU ahead of I and P.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue soldiers with kit is to supply or provide them, which is what equip means.

clue.text: Untainted and of a certain steely character?

definitions.meaning: free from any mark or blemish
a rust-resistant chromium alloy is called ... steel

explanation.definitionFit: The word means spotless, and it also names the corrosion-resistant variety of steel.

clue.text: Cardinal associated with sign of the cross

definitions.meaning: a cardinal number is a counting number such as one, two or three
the cross-shaped X is the Roman numeral for this number

explanation.walkthrough: 'associated with' links the two definitions. 'Cardinal' suggests a churchman, which the cross supports, but it is a counting number.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a cardinal number, and the Roman numeral X, a cross shape, stands for it.

clue.text: Forlorn little man, old and nearly at the end

parts.note: Des is a short form of the man's name Desmond
late means towards the close of a period, as in late in the day

explanation.surface: A small elderly fellow is miserable as his life draws to a close.
explanation.definitionFit: Desolate describes someone bleak, abandoned and wretched, a synonym of forlorn.

clue.text: What could be graffiti by lout in the capital

parts.note: a hob is an old word for a rustic or clownish fellow
graffiti is sometimes regarded as street art

explanation.surface: A yob has sprayed his scrawl on a wall in a big city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just sets the pieces beside each other. HOBART is the capital of Tasmania, in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: Hobart is the chief city and seat of government of the Australian state of Tasmania.

clue.text: Sporting females given special treatment in a newsroom

indicators.note: the letters are handled in an unusual way, which is to say rearranged

explanation.surface: Sportswomen are treated as stars by the staff of a news office.
explanation.definitionFit: Women who row crews in races are sportswomen, so the plural fits sporting females.

clue.text: Medley Scotsman played on air

parts.note: Mac is a nickname for a Scotsman, from the prefix of many Scottish surnames

indicators.note: the words are played about with, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Scottish musician performs a mixture of tunes over the radio.
explanation.definitionFit: Chambers lists a medley or jumble as one sense of macaroni, from macaronic verse mixing languages.

clue.text: Cook, former England cricketer

definitions.meaning: C. B. ... was an England batsman and captain in the early 1900s

explanation.walkthrough: Alastair Cook was also an England cricketer, which makes the surface read as one person.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means cooking in oil, and the surname is that of a famous all-round English sportsman.

clue.text: Criminal trickster — new leader

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is replaced by a different one

parts.note: a trickster is a deceiver

explanation.surface: A crooked con artist takes over as the gang's boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new leader' swaps the D of DECEIVER for R.
explanation.definitionFit: A receiver is a person who knowingly handles stolen goods, a criminal.

clue.text: Foreign character seen in the taxi

indicators.note: the letters can be seen lying within the words that follow

explanation.surface: An overseas visitor is spotted riding in a cab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Foreign character' suggests a person; it is a letter of the Greek alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet, so a character from a foreign script.

clue.text: Bone in meat devoured

parts.note: ham is a type of meat
devoured means ate

explanation.surface: A bone was found in some meat that had been eaten.
explanation.definitionFit: The hamate is a small hooked bone of the wrist.

clue.text: Mysterious halo over theologian

indicators.note: in a down entry the ring-shaped letter sits on top of the rest

parts.note: a halo is ring-shaped, like the letter O
DD stands for Doctor of Divinity, a theology degree

explanation.surface: A strange glowing ring hovers above a learned divine.
explanation.definitionFit: Odd means strange or puzzling, close to mysterious.

clue.text: Agricultural product provides fellow with money

parts.note: a fellow is a man
gold stands for wealth or money

explanation.surface: Farm produce gives a man a good income.
explanation.definitionFit: Mangold, or mangel-wurzel, is a beet grown as cattle feed, a farm crop.

clue.text: Arrange time for equestrian activity

parts.note: to dress a window display or troops in line is to arrange them
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Set aside some hours for horse riding.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressage is the training and display of a horse in precise movements, a horse-riding discipline.

clue.text: Music has upset listener eating food

indicators.note: the turned word takes in the food, which goes inside it
in a down entry, upset means the word is turned upside down, read from the bottom

parts.note: an ear is the organ of hearing, a listener
an egg is a simple item of food

explanation.surface: A listener is put off a tune while having a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry 'upset' turns the listener word upside down, and 'eating' puts the food inside it; 'has' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Reggae is a Jamaican style of popular music.

clue.text: Nine finish, almost (almost!) getting stuck

indicators.note: the shortened word is stuck inside the word for finish

parts.note: the end is the finish

indicators.note: the bracketed repeat says to shorten the synonym again by its final letter

parts.note: near means almost, as in a near disaster

explanation.surface: Nine competitors very nearly reach the end before becoming bogged down.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated, bracketed '(almost!)' is a joke: shorten the synonym of 'almost' once more by its last letter before 'getting stuck' lodges it in the finish word.
explanation.definitionFit: An ennead is a group or set of nine things, from the Greek for nine.

clue.text: Deep caver in trouble in the country

indicators.note: letters in trouble are in disarray, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A potholer deep underground gets into difficulties abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Cape Verde is an island nation off the west coast of Africa.

clue.text: The foreign spirit in a Scottish city

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the
gin is an alcoholic spirit

explanation.surface: Imported liquor is drunk in a northern town.
explanation.definitionFit: Elgin is a historic cathedral city in Moray, in north-east Scotland.

clue.text: Instrument decapitated Welshman

indicators.note: the head, or first letter, is cut off

parts.note: Morgan is a typical Welsh man's name

explanation.surface: A tool was used to behead a man from Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: The organ is a keyboard musical instrument, as found in churches.

clue.text: Overlook number holding endless wild party

indicators.note: the number contains the shortened party word inside it

parts.note: five is a number

indicators.note: the last letter is cut off

parts.note: an orgy is a wild party

explanation.surface: Ignore the count of people at an unruly gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Overlook' looks like 'fail to notice', but here it means 'excuse'. 'endless' trims the party word, and 'holding' puts it inside the number.
explanation.definitionFit: To overlook an offence is to pardon or excuse it, which is what forgive means.

clue.text: Animal to be ill falling back in shrub

parts.note: a camel is an animal
to ail is to be ill

explanation.surface: A beast becomes sick and collapses into the bushes.
explanation.definitionFit: The camellia is an evergreen flowering bush from eastern Asia.

clue.text: Tailor somewhere in Middlesex?

definitions.meaning: a dressmaker or tailor fixes cloth with pins, so is one who pins
A suburb in the old county of Middlesex, now part of north-west London

explanation.walkthrough: Middlesex is a former English county, now largely absorbed into Greater London.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinner is someone who fastens with pins, like a tailor, and also a London suburb.
